items_all.title: Sakana AI's self-improving model gets better at solving and judging, but can't catch its own blind spots
items_all.summary: Sakana AI's MASS method lets one language model improve itself by solving tasks, judging results, and refining workflows, reaching a win rate of nearly 70 percent against the base model after two rounds. But when the model misses the same errors across all three roles, it can mistake them for progress and reinforce them during training. The article Sakana AI's self-improving model gets better at solving and judging, but can't catch its own blind spots appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Sakana AI 的 MASS 方法讓單一語言模型透過解決任務、評估結果以及改善工作流程來自我提升，在經過兩輪後，對基礎模型的勝率接近百分之七十。但是，當模型在所有三個角色中都漏掉相同的錯誤時，它可能會將其誤認為是進展並在訓練期間加以強化。這篇文章 Sakana AI's self-improving model gets better at solving and judging, but can't catch its own blind spots 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions
items_all.summary: Microsoft researchers found that autonomous AI agents get trapped in what they call "idea basins" because of their growing chat context, local solution regions they can't escape. Their "Fork-and-Flush" method clears the chat history but keeps the workspace, achieving up to 66 percent better results on the same compute budget. The article Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 微軟 研究人員發現，自主式 AI 代理因不斷增長的聊天上下文而陷入他們所謂的「想法盆地」（idea basins），也就是無法逃脫的局部解答區域。他們的「分岔與清除」（Fork-and-Flush）方法能清除聊天記錄但保留工作區，在相同的運算預算下，可達到高達 66% 的更好成果。文章〈清除聊天記錄有助於 AI 代理找到更好的解決方案〉（Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions）最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Microsoft plans to scale its own Maia AI chips to gigawatt levels by 2027
items_all.summary: Microsoft will make its in-house Azure Maia chips the main AI inference system across its products starting in 2027, deploying them at multi-gigawatt scale. The upcoming Maia 300 should deliver 40 percent more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems. CEO Satya Nadella calls it "our biggest bet yet on our own silicon." The article Microsoft plans to scale its own Maia AI chips to gigawatt levels by 2027 appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 微軟 將從 2027 年開始在其產品中全面採用自家研發的 Azure Maia 晶片作為主要的 AI 推論系統，並以多吉瓦（multi-gigawatt）的規模進行部署。即將推出的 Maia 300 預計每百萬瓦產出的權杖（tokens）數量將比領先的 GPU 系統多出 40%。執行長薩帝亞·納德拉（Satya Nadella）稱其為「我們至今對自有晶片最大的一場賭注」。這篇題為 微軟 plans to scale its own Maia AI chips to gigawatt levels by 2027 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

In September, the Trump administration had told the companies to stop sharing their models with the British agency. Diplomatic pressure from AI Minister Kanishka Narayan led to the reversal. items_all.title: Anthropic's Andrej Karpathy says "the external world has seen the preview" of what AI can actually do
items_all.summary: Andrej Karpathy, co-founder of OpenAI and now at Anthropic, sees a widening knowledge gap in AI. About 75 percent of the world's population has barely touched LLMs. Roughly 5,000 people, meanwhile, have access to internal frontier systems whose agent swarms do work that would take top experts years. The public, at best, sees a weird chatbot. The article Anthropic's Andrej Karpathy says "the external world has seen the preview" of what AI can actually do appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 的共同創辦人、目前任職於 Anthropic 的 Andrej Karpathy 看到人工智慧領域正在擴大的知識落差。大約有全球 75% 的人口幾乎沒有接觸過 LLMs。同時，大約有 5,000 人能夠存取內部的最先進系統，其代理群集（agent swarms）所做的工作是頂尖專家需要花費數年才能完成的。大眾頂多只看到一個奇怪的聊天機器人。這篇題為 Anthropic's Andrej Karpathy 說「外部世界已經看過」人工智慧實際能力的預告片的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
items_all.summary: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems, including nine Erdős problems two of which were unsolved for 56 years, per a study in Science. The publication comes as OpenAI faces a boycott for dumping AI proofs on GitHub without peer review. Deepmind had its results reviewed before publishing. The article Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據《科學》雜誌的一項研究，Google Deepmind 的 AlphaProof Nexus 解決了數十個開放性數學問題，其中包括九個埃爾德什問題，其中兩個已經懸而未決 56 年。這篇論文發表之際，OpenAI 正因將未經同行評審的 AI 證明傾倒到 GitHub 上而面臨抵制。Deepmind 在發布前對其結果進行了同行評審。文章 Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI 沒搶走程序員飯碗？美初級碼農就業反降 20%，專家憂十年後斷檔
items_all.summary: CNBC報道，自2025年2月Anthropic的Claude Code問世後，美國軟體開發職位釋出量不降反增。Indeed Hiring Lab資料顯示，軟體崗招聘逆勢上漲近15%，整體就業市場卻縮水7%。麥肯錫北美區主席庫切並不意外：企業寫程式碼總量創新高，AI時代開發者需求仍堅挺。但增長高度集中於資深與AI相關崗位，高階職位吃掉了主要增量。

items_all.title: 宇樹科技王興興發聲：過去犯的最大錯誤是不夠相信 AI，具身智能臨界點最快一兩年內爆發
items_all.summary: 在第二十六屆中國國際工業博覽會開幕式上，宇樹科技創始人王興興演講稱，回顧創業歷程，自己最大錯誤是對人工智能發展“相信得還不夠”。針對具身智能何時爆發，他給出具體判定標準：當機器人能在80%的陌生未知場景中，僅憑人類語音指令就順利完成任務，便意味着其迎來爆發。該標準強調開放場景泛化與自然語音交互能力，也反映出他對AI驅動機器人躍遷的重新判斷。

items_all.title: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
items_all.summary: TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available. The post TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: TII 發布了 Falcon-ASR，這是一個具備阿拉伯聯合大公國特色、規模達 16 億參數的阿拉伯語語音辨識模型。它在 6 個阿拉伯語測試集上平均字詞錯誤率 (WER) 為 20.92%，但權重與 API 尚未推出。這篇文章 TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.summary: 蘋果將於10月13日發佈新一代智能家居產品：搭載A18芯片的HomeView、S10芯片的新款HomePod mini和A19芯片的Apple TV。古爾曼10月12日透露，HomeView有桌面和壁掛版，配顯示屏，定位家庭智能控制中樞，預計11月中旬上市；另兩款10月30日開售，有望進一步整合蘋果智能家居生態。

items_all.summary: 微軟CEO納德拉10月10日髮長文，呼籲行業爲先進AI模型引入“緊急制動”，徹底評估現有AI信任架構。他指出，面對迅速演進的超級智能，不能盲目將複雜黑箱模型視爲全知全能，而應從“模型已被攻破”的防禦假設出發，推行審慎安全治理，並在具體技術框架上主張調整底層AI模型。

items_all.title: AI 購物新玩法引發爭議！馬斯克稱拍信用卡即可下單，遭 OpenAI 高管公開嘲諷
items_all.summary: 埃隆·馬斯克在社交平臺公開介紹Grok機器人全新購物功能。按其說法，用戶只需隨手拍一張信用卡照片發送到聊天框，Grok就能自動全網搜索並對比商品最優價格，隨後直接替用戶完成下單。這一顛覆性便捷購物構想迅速引發科技界熱議，但其安全隱患也立刻招來同行質疑，OpenAI高管Tibo隨後在社交平臺對其提出質疑。

items_all.title: Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text
items_all.summary: Cloudflare released Clef-omni, an Apache-2.0 multimodal decision model built on Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B. It scores text, images, audio and video in one call for $0.15 per million input tokens, while Clef-flash drops to $0.038. The post Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Cloudflare 發布了 Clef-omni，這是一個基於 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 構建的 Apache-2.0 多模態決策模型。它能在單次呼叫中對文字、圖片、語音和影片進行評分，每百萬個輸入 Token 的費用為 0.15 美元，而 Clef-flash 則降至 0.038 美元。這篇文章 Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models
items_all.summary: vLLM Semantic Router released Decision 3.0, 5 Apache-2.0 multimodal decision models from 0.8B to 27B. They answer choice, yes/no and score questions about text and images in one call, without generating text. The post What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: vLLM 語義路由器（Semantic Router）發布了 Decision 3.0，包含 5 個規模從 0.8B 到 27B 的 Apache-2.0 多模態決策模型。它們能在單次呼叫中回答關於文字和圖片的選擇題、是/否題與評分問題，且不會生成文字。這篇部落格文章〈什麼是 Decision 3.0？vLLM 語義路由器的全新開放決策模型〉（What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models）最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.summary: Python 3.15 is here ! Here's the essential What's new in Python 3.15 guide, this year curated by 3.14 and 3.15 release manager Hugo van Kemenade. As someone who builds open source software that works in every supported Python version, I get to say goodbye to Python 3.10 and start embracing features from Python 3.11. First, some highlights from Python 3.15. Explicit lazy imports I'm most excited about Explicit lazy imports from PEP 810 . These let you import modules like so: lazy import json lazy from pathlib import Path The module will then be imported the first time those symbols are used in the code that follows. My LLM CLI tool implements plugins. I had to recommend manual lazy imports in the plugin author documentation, because simply installing plugins that used heavy dependencies such as sentence_transformers could add multiple seconds to every invocation of the llm command. Lazy imports directly address this startup cost. Unpacking in comprehensions The new [*sublist for sublist in lists] unpacking syntax is neat. Here's an illustration lifted from the documentation : lists = [[ 1 , 2 ], [ 3 , 4 ], [ 5 ]] [ * L for L in lists ] # [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] # equivalent to [x for L in lists for x in L] sets = [{ 1 , 2 }, { 2 , 3 }, { 3 , 4 }] { * s for s in sets } # {1, 2, 3, 4} # equivalent to {x for s in sets for x in s} dicts = [{ 'a' : 1 }, { 'b' : 2 }, { 'a' : 3 }] { ** d for d in dicts } # {'a': 3, 'b': 2} # equivalent to {k: v for d in dicts for k,v in d.items()} PEP 798: Unpacking in Comprehensions by Adam Hartz and Erik Demaine proposed this as an extension of the unpac

items_all_raw.title: Hello Python 3.15, goodbye 3.10, and now I can use 3.11
items_all_raw.summary: Python 3.15 is here ! Here's the essential What's new in Python 3.15 guide, this year curated by 3.14 and 3.15 release manager Hugo van Kemenade. As someone who builds open source software that works in every supported Python version, I get to say goodbye to Python 3.10 and start embracing features from Python 3.11. First, some highlights from Python 3.15. Explicit lazy imports I'm most excited about Explicit lazy imports from PEP 810 . These let you import modules like so: lazy import json lazy from pathlib import Path The module will then be imported the first time those symbols are used in the code that follows. My LLM CLI tool implements plugins. I had to recommend manual lazy imports in the plugin author documentation, because simply installing plugins that used heavy dependencies such as sentence_transformers could add multiple seconds to every invocation of the llm command. Lazy imports directly address this startup cost. Unpacking in comprehensions The new [*sublist for sublist in lists] unpacking syntax is neat. Here's an illustration lifted from the documentation : lists = [[ 1 , 2 ], [ 3 , 4 ], [ 5 ]] [ * L for L in lists ] # [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] # equivalent to [x for L in lists for x in L] sets = [{ 1 , 2 }, { 2 , 3 }, { 3 , 4 }] { * s for s in sets } # {1, 2, 3, 4} # equivalent to {x for s in sets for x in s} dicts = [{ 'a' : 1 }, { 'b' : 2 }, { 'a' : 3 }] { ** d for d in dicts } # {'a': 3, 'b': 2} # equivalent to {k: v for d in dicts for k,v in d.items()} PEP 798: Unpacking in Comprehensions by Adam Hartz and Erik Demaine proposed this as an extension of the unpac

items_all_raw.summary: Sakana AI's MASS method lets one language model improve itself by solving tasks, judging results, and refining workflows, reaching a win rate of nearly 70 percent against the base model after two rounds. But when the model misses the same errors across all three roles, it can mistake them for progress and reinforce them during training. items_all_raw.title: Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions
items_all_raw.summary: Microsoft researchers found that autonomous AI agents get trapped in what they call "idea basins" because of their growing chat context, local solution regions they can't escape. Their "Fork-and-Flush" method clears the chat history but keeps the workspace, achieving up to 66 percent better results on the same compute budget. The article Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 微軟 研究人員發現，自主式 AI 代理因不斷增長的聊天上下文而陷入他們所謂的「想法盆地」（idea basins），也就是無法逃脫的局部解答區域。他們的「分岔與清除」（Fork-and-Flush）方法能清除聊天記錄但保留工作區，在相同的運算預算下，可達到高達 66% 的更好成果。文章〈清除聊天記錄有助於 AI 代理找到更好的解決方案〉（Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions）最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: Andrej Karpathy, co-founder of OpenAI and now at Anthropic, sees a widening knowledge gap in AI. About 75 percent of the world's population has barely touched LLMs. Roughly 5,000 people, meanwhile, have access to internal frontier systems whose agent swarms do work that would take top experts years. The public, at best, sees a weird chatbot. The article Anthropic's Andrej Karpathy says "the external world has seen the preview" of what AI can actually do appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 的共同創辦人、目前任職於 Anthropic 的 Andrej Karpathy 看到人工智慧領域正在擴大的知識落差。大約有全球 75% 的人口幾乎沒有接觸過 LLMs。同時，大約有 5,000 人能夠存取內部的最先進系統，其代理群集（agent swarms）所做的工作是頂尖專家需要花費數年才能完成的。大眾頂多只看到一個奇怪的聊天機器人。這篇題為 Anthropic's Andrej Karpathy 說「外部世界已經看過」人工智慧實際能力的預告片的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
items_all_raw.summary: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems, including nine Erdős problems two of which were unsolved for 56 years, per a study in Science. The publication comes as OpenAI faces a boycott for dumping AI proofs on GitHub without peer review. Deepmind had its results reviewed before publishing. The article Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據《科學》雜誌的一項研究，Google Deepmind 的 AlphaProof Nexus 解決了數十個開放性數學問題，其中包括九個埃爾德什問題，其中兩個已經懸而未決 56 年。這篇論文發表之際，OpenAI 正因將未經同行評審的 AI 證明傾倒到 GitHub 上而面臨抵制。Deepmind 在發布前對其結果進行了同行評審。文章 Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: 蘋果招募由NotebookLM前員工合組的AI podcast App公司Huxe
items_all_raw.summary: 近日一份公告文件顯示，蘋果於今年春天招募了Google NotebookLM前團隊成員創立的AI podcast App業者Huxe核心成員並取得技術授權。 根據歐盟列出大廠申報的收購清單，蘋果在今年6月向Huxe AI提出員工招募提案，招募了特定員工，並獲得後者智財權的非獨家技術授權。 蘋果描述Huxe開發的是建造個人化音訊內容的手機應用程式。

items_all_raw.summary: 在第二十六屆中國國際工業博覽會開幕式上，宇樹科技創始人王興興演講稱，回顧創業歷程，自己最大錯誤是對人工智能發展“相信得還不夠”。針對具身智能何時爆發，他給出具體判定標準：當機器人能在80%的陌生未知場景中，僅憑人類語音指令就順利完成任務，便意味着其迎來爆發。該標準強調開放場景泛化與自然語音交互能力，也反映出他對AI驅動機器人躍遷的重新判斷。

items_all_raw.title: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
items_all_raw.summary: TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available. The post TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: TII 發布了 Falcon-ASR，這是一個具備阿拉伯聯合大公國特色、規模達 16 億參數的阿拉伯語語音辨識模型。它在 6 個阿拉伯語測試集上平均字詞錯誤率 (WER) 為 20.92%，但權重與 API 尚未推出。這篇文章 TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text
items_all_raw.summary: Cloudflare released Clef-omni, an Apache-2.0 multimodal decision model built on Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B. It scores text, images, audio and video in one call for $0.15 per million input tokens, while Clef-flash drops to $0.038. The post Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Cloudflare 發布了 Clef-omni，這是一個基於 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 構建的 Apache-2.0 多模態決策模型。它能在單次呼叫中對文字、圖片、語音和影片進行評分，每百萬個輸入 Token 的費用為 0.15 美元，而 Clef-flash 則降至 0.038 美元。這篇文章 Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models
items_all_raw.summary: vLLM Semantic Router released Decision 3.0, 5 Apache-2.0 multimodal decision models from 0.8B to 27B. They answer choice, yes/no and score questions about text and images in one call, without generating text. The post What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: vLLM 語義路由器（Semantic Router）發布了 Decision 3.0，包含 5 個規模從 0.8B 到 27B 的 Apache-2.0 多模態決策模型。它們能在單次呼叫中回答關於文字和圖片的選擇題、是/否題與評分問題，且不會生成文字。這篇部落格文章〈什麼是 Decision 3.0？vLLM 語義路由器的全新開放決策模型〉（What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models）最初發布於 MarkTechPost。
